name: adhd
description: Anchoring Defeat by Heterogeneous Divergence: N isolated subagents under distorted frames, a blind critic, mechanical trap detectors, and adversarial deepening.

plugins.name: adhd
plugins.description: Runs a reasoning problem through five to seven isolated subagents under deliberately distorted frames, scores them blind against a rubric that punishes fluency, prunes on eight written trap detectors, and ships what it pruned along with what it kept.
